subject: MdeModulePkg: Change EndofDxeEvent TPLs to TPL_CALLBACK
reasons: Simple, uniform substitution of TPL_NOTIFY with TPL_CALLBACK at two CreateEventEx call sites in two separate files in MdeModulePkg
Well-defined before/after pattern: within gBS->CreateEventEx calls targeting gEfiEndOfDxeEventGroupGuid, change the TPL argument from TPL_NOTIFY to TPL_CALLBACK
Paired with its revert commit 8c50e656c0 (neighbor offset +2 direction older) which does the inverse — both are structurally equivalent Coccinelle candidates
The pattern (CreateEventEx with a specific event group GUID and a specific TPL) is mechanically expressible in SmPL
candidate_pattern:
@@
expression callback;
expression ctx;
expression event;
@@
gBS->CreateEventEx(
   EVT_NOTIFY_SIGNAL,
-  TPL_NOTIFY,
+  TPL_CALLBACK,
   callback,
   ctx,
   &gEfiEndOfDxeEventGroupGuid,
   event
)
